channel.description: AI phone agents for local businesses and agencies

item.title: Can an AI phone agent book appointments into GoHighLevel?
item.description: Yes. GoHighLevel's API can list free slots and create appointments, so an AI phone agent can book on the call. Here is how it works and where it breaks.

item.title: AI receptionist vs answering service: which one books the job?
item.description: A live answering service takes messages. An AI receptionist can book the job on the call. Here is where each one wins, and where neither is enough.

item.title: How many calls does a plumber miss, and what does each cost?
item.description: Published data says home-service businesses miss between 14% and 48% of calls, depending on the definition. Here is how to find and price your own number.

item.title: How we test AI phone agents before they take real calls
item.description: We run every AI phone agent against 38 simulated callers before launch. What we measure, the mistakes it catches, and why "it sounded fine" is not a test.

item.title: How much does an AI receptionist cost for a small business in 2026?
item.description: Real prices for an AI phone agent in 2026: setup, monthly fees, per-minute costs, and how it compares with a part-time receptionist or an answering service.
